tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Convert one address, place name or postal code into latitude/longitude coordinates. Returns the matched address and coordinates, or found=false. Costs $0.001. For several addresses use batch_geocode.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Find the street address at a latitude/longitude point. Costs $0.001. For several points use batch_reverse_geocode.

tools.name: batch_geocode
tools.description: Geocode up to 50 addresses in one call. Results come back in input order, each with found=true/false. Costs $0.001 per address.

tools.name: batch_reverse_geocode
tools.description: Find the street addresses of up to 50 latitude/longitude points in one call, in input order. Costs $0.001 per point.

tools.name: distance
tools.description: Road distance and travel time between two latitude/longitude points (or the straight-line distance with vehicle=direct). Costs $0.001; nothing is charged if no route is found. To start from addresses, geocode them first.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Road route through 2 to 25 points in the given order: distance and time of every leg and the total, optionally with the route shape. Costs $0.001 per leg (N points = N-1 legs); nothing is charged if routing fails.

tools.name: account_balance
tools.description: Free. The remaining balance of the Geloky API wallet in USD, requests made so far, the price per request and where to top up.
